text: The cosmological principle, which underlies the FLRW model, states that on large scales (≳ 300 Mpc) the universe is:
choices: expanding outward from the Milky Way as its center
explanation: The cosmological principle asserts homogeneity (the same at every point — no special location) and isotropy (the same in every direction — no special direction). It is not a claim that the universe is static (it evolves) nor that it has a central point; homogeneity specifically forbids a special center such as the Milky Way. Whether space is a closed 3-sphere is a separate question about the curvature k, not part of the principle.
